facts.fact: Daily News reports the ICT minister said more than 500 public servants have been trained in emerging technologies to design, develop and manage government digital systems.
facts.system: Public servant training in emerging technologies

facts.fact: Daily News reports the minister said government is expanding open-source technology across public institutions so that it owns and controls its digital infrastructure and protects critical government information.

TZA.note: No statement bearing on this question.
Says local experts develop and manage government systems and staff were trained, but names no system run or built by government staff.
